name: RFP Interpret Addendum
description: Lists the typed changes an addendum makes (ADR-0010 amendment 1); code verifies and applies them.

inputs.sample:
ADDENDUM NO. 2
[C.1] XY-002 is revised to read: "The vendor must respond within 2 hours." (M)
[C.2] XY-003 is deleted.
[C.3] The proposal due date is extended to March 3, 2027.
Respondents must acknowledge this addendum.

changes.newText: The vendor must respond within 2 hours.
